## bookmarks/tests/test_bundle_filters_blind_api.py

Most of the coverage sits here, as the strategy asks. It uses `LinkdingApiTestCase`, `BookmarkFactoryMixin` and `BookmarkListTestMixin`. `setup_bundle` can't take the new fields at this commit, so any bundle with a state set is created through `POST /api/bundles/`. Today that call accepts and silently drops the new fields, so the tests fail on what comes back, not on a missing name.

Class `BundleFilterStateApiTestCase`:
- **`test_create_and_get_bundle_returns_filter_unread_and_filter_shared` (AC1):** the values given on create come back from `GET` on the bundle and in the `/api/bundles/` list. It uses `yes`/`no` and then `no`/`yes`, so swapped fields are caught.
- **`test_create_bundle_without_states_defaults_to_off` (AC1):** a bundle created without the fields returns `"off"` for both.
- **`test_patch_bundle_changes_filter_unread_and_filter_shared` (AC2):** PATCHes one field at a time, then both, then back to off. After each step it checks with `GET` that the other field and the other bundle conditions are unchanged.
- **`test_put_bundle_sets_filter_unread_and_filter_shared` (contract):** PUT with both fields given explicitly. What PUT does when they are left out is unspecified in the ticket, so I don't assert it.
- **`test_bookmarks_api_bundle_filter_unread_yes_no_off` (AC3):** matching unread and read bookmarks plus non-matching ones. The expected sets for yes, no and off all differ. Some matching bookmarks are shared, so leaving the sharing state at its default (off) must not drop them.
- **`test_bookmarks_api_bundle_filter_shared_yes_no_off` (AC4):** the same check for the sharing state.
- **`test_bookmarks_api_bundle_without_states_matches_all_states`:** the fallback test above.
- **`test_bookmarks_api_bundle_combines_states_with_search_and_tags` (AC5):** three bundles over one set of bookmarks:
  - unread + shared, with search, required tag and excluded tag;
  - read + unshared, with the same conditions;
  - unread + unshared, using "any tags".

  Each decoy bookmark fails exactly one condition, so an OR instead of an AND, or a dropped condition, gets caught.
- **`test_bookmark_list_page_bundle_applies_unread_and_shared_conditions` (AC5, list page):** the server-rendered `/bookmarks?bundle=<id>` page is a separate code path from the API. It is rendered with `self.client` after `force_login`.

Class `BundleFilterStateFormTestCase` covers AC6 at server level, so this criterion has a test that can run here. It finds each dropdown by its visible label ("Reading State", "Sharing State") and that label's `for` attribute. It posts the value of the option whose text is "Unread", "Read" and so on, so it never assumes the form's field names or option values.
- **`test_new_bundle_form_shows_and_stores_reading_and_sharing_state`:** checks the options "All, Unread, Read" and "All, Shared, Unshared" with "All" selected by default. It saves Unread and Shared, checks the API returns `yes`/`yes`, checks the edit form has both preselected, and checks the bundle's list page shows only the matching bookmark.
- **`test_edit_bundle_form_stores_reading_and_sharing_state`:** sets Read and Unshared on an existing bundle. The API then returns `no`/`no` and the list page shows only the matching bookmark.

These form tests and the list-page test are in the API file because only these two new file names were allowed, and both are pages that `self.client` can check.

## bookmarks/tests_e2e/e2e_test_bundle_filters_blind.py

These are the browser tests, two of them, as the strategy allows. They cover the path a user sees:
- **`test_create_bundle_with_reading_and_sharing_state`:** on `/bundles/new`, first assert both dropdowns are visible with their options and "All" selected. Then select Unread, then Shared, and check the preview text "Found N bookmarks matching this bundle" and the listed bookmarks each time. Save, reopen the edit form to check both are preselected, then open `/bookmarks?bundle=<id>` and check only matching bookmarks are listed.
- **`test_edit_bundle_reading_and_sharing_state`:** the same steps from the edit form, choosing Read and Unshared.

There are 8 bookmarks in four groups, so every step gives a different count (8, 3, 2 and 8, 5, 2). A preview that hasn't updated can't pass the next check, and no count is 1, so it doesn't matter whether the template says "bookmark" or "bookmarks". The group titles (Kiwi, Lime, Mango, Papaya) don't contain each other, which matters because Playwright's `has_text` matches substrings. Options are chosen and checked by their visible text, never by value: the ticket fixes the labels, not the option values.

## Assumptions not in the ticket

- **Sharing enabled on the profile:** the form and browser tests switch it on, because the existing search form hides its sharing filter when sharing is off. The API tests leave it off, because the ticket's contract depends only on each bookmark's `shared` field.
- **No mocks or waits:** nothing mocks application code and nothing sleeps. The only existing names used are `BookmarkBundle` and existing route names.
